report:
Vulva, left labium majus, wide excision

Received in formalin is a wide excision specimen of vulva measuring 60 x 40 x 15 mm. The specimen is orientated: suture at 12 o'clock. There is an ulcerated tumour on the left labium majus measuring 24 x 15 x 6 mm, 8 mm from the closest (deep) margin. The margins are inked. Representative sections are taken in 10 blocks.

(1-4) Tumour with deep margin.
(5-8) Peripheral margins, 12 to 9 o'clock.
(9-10) Adjacent skin.

Specimen and tumour
- Procedure: Wide excision
- Tumour site: Left labium majus
- Tumour size: 24 mm (greatest dimension)
- Tumour focality: Unifocal

Microscopic findings
- Histologic type: Squamous cell carcinoma, HPV-independent
- Tumour histology:
  The tumour is an HPV-independent squamous cell carcinoma with a keratinising pattern, invading to a depth of 4.5 mm. Infiltrating nests and cords of atypical squamous cells show abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm, intercellular bridges and keratin pearls. On immunohistochemistry, p16 is negative and p53 shows an abnormal pattern of basal overexpression.
- Depth of invasion: 4.5 mm (conventional method: 5 mm)
- Tumour border: Infiltrating
- Other tissue / organ involvement: Not identified
- Lymphovascular invasion: Not identified
- Perineural invasion: Not identified

Margins
- Invasive carcinoma, peripheral margin: Uninvolved (closest 9 mm, 3 o'clock)
- Invasive carcinoma, deep margin: Uninvolved (closest 6 mm)
- Squamous precursor lesion (dVIN): Uninvolved (closest 3 mm, peripheral,
  6 o'clock)

Lymph nodes
- Regional lymph nodes: 2 examined (sentinel lymph node biopsy); none involved

Pathological stage (AJCC 9th edition)
- pTNM: pT1b pN0(sn)

Additional findings
- Adjacent epithelium: Differentiated VIN (dVIN); lichen sclerosus

VULVA, left labium majus, wide excision
- SQUAMOUS CELL CARCINOMA, HPV-INDEPENDENT, 24 mm, invading to a depth of
  4.5 mm; completely excised (closest margin 6 mm, deep); see synoptic report
- 0 of 2 sentinel lymph nodes involved
- pT1b pN0(sn) (AJCC 9th edition)
- Background differentiated VIN (dVIN) and lichen sclerosus

Depth of invasion is measured by the FIGO 2021 method.
